name: Town hotel
description: Five-storey town hotel, 24 x 16 m: a limestone-clad ground floor with a glazed lobby, a flat entrance canopy and a vertical blank sign blade, four rendered upper floors with Juliet balconies and a warm accent band. Inside: the lobby with a fixed reception desk, a dining room across the front, kitchen, office, store and toilets behind; four upper floors of guest rooms either side of a central corridor with a linen room; a stair core rising to a roof door behind a parapet, a lift, roof plant.
